pr.title: feat(dcp): helper-receipt v1 + emitter + redactor (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-106)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Evolves `dcp_helper_receipt` schema to the full DR-015 §8 field set per design C.1 and amendments A3/A4/A5/A6/A8.
- All fields provenance-tagged in-schema as EXTERNAL_PROPOSED or REPO_VALIDATED with named reconciliation targets.
- Replaces the `redact_secret_like` placeholder stub with a real multi-pattern redactor covering: known token prefixes (ghp_, ghs_, github_pat_, sk-, sk-ant-, AKIA-family), KEY=VALUE env capture where KEY matches (KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|CREDENTIAL), URL userinfo (://user:pass@), PEM blocks, and Authorization header values.
- Introduces `src/dopemux/dcp/receipts.py` emitter; prefers direct .git/HEAD and refs file parsing for branch and head sha; falls back to subprocess git only when unavoidable and adds receipts.py to the text-rule exemption list per amendment A8.
- Adds `.dcp/` entry to `.gitignore` (currently missing, amendment A6).
- Provenance-completeness gate: all schema fields must have a provenance tag and a reconciliation target before schema is locked.
- Ships hand-authored proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-106/APPROVAL.json per design B.6 (redlane packet touches schemas/dcp/**).

## Validation
- Schema round-trip parse.
- Property tests: no secrets in receipts including short tokens, URL-auth strings, PEM blocks; hash chain verifies.
- Provenance-tag completeness gate passes.
- Redactor covers all declared pattern classes.

## NOT_RUN
- CLI integration (TP-107).
- Evidence-pack hash-locking (TP-108).
- Live hook receipt writes (requires TP-105).

## Residual Risks
- `.git/` parsing is a local read; worktree edge cases are explicitly tested.
- Provenance for `receipt_id`/`packet_id`/`parent_receipt_id` remains EXTERNAL_PROPOSED until first-producer reconciliation in TP-108.

steps.task: Preflight: verify DMX-DCP-TOOLING-101 is merged (manifest.json present), inspect current dcp_helper_receipt schema, confirm .dcp/ is absent from .gitignore, and confirm redact_secret_like is a stub.
validation: Current dcp_helper_receipt schema is inspected; gap from full DR-015 §8 set is documented.
redact_secret_like confirmed as a placeholder stub.

steps.task: Evolve schemas/dcp/dcp_helper_receipt.schema.json to the full DR-015 §8 field set per design C.1 and amendments A3/A4. Add fields: helper_name, helper_version, policy_version, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, model, mutations[] (with attempted+performed+blocked structure), sensitivity.redacted. Tag every field with its provenance (EXTERNAL_PROPOSED or REPO_VALIDATED) and named reconciliation target in the schema description or x-provenance extension. Ensure no silent drops: any removed or renamed field from the previous schema version is recorded in a schema changelog comment.
validation: Every top-level field has a provenance tag (EXTERNAL_PROPOSED or REPO_VALIDATED) in its description or x-provenance field.
fields helper_name, helper_version, policy_version, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, model, mutations, sensitivity are all present.
Previous fields from prior schema version are either present or their removal is documented.

steps.task: Implement the real multi-pattern redactor in src/dopemux/dcp/receipts.py (or as redact_secret_like in a shared module imported by receipts.py and red_lane_rules.py). Pattern classes to implement: (1) known token prefixes — ghp_, ghs_, github_pat_, sk-, sk-ant-, AKIA followed by 16+ uppercase alphanum; (2) KEY=VALUE env capture where KEY case-insensitively matches (KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|CREDENTIAL|API_KEY|AUTH); (3) URL userinfo component (://user:pass@); (4) PEM blocks (-----BEGIN [A-Z ]+-----); (5) Authorization header values (Authorization: (Bearer|Basic|Token) <value>). Apply per-field to invocation/args/env captures — not blanket over forensic match evidence. The same redactor is importable by the SECRETS-IN-ARGV lane detector.

Implement src/dopemux/dcp/receipts.py emitter. The emitter must: (1) prefer direct .git/HEAD and .git/refs parsing for branch and head_sha; (2) fall back to subprocess git only when direct parsing is impossible and record this in a structured emitter log; (3) emit receipts to .dcp/receipts/<session-or-run>/rcpt_<ulid>.json; (4) support JSONL append mode for hooks (hooks-<session>.jsonl); (5) apply the redactor to all invocation/args/env fields before write; (6) compute integrity.sha256 over the canonical receipt body; (7) support parent_receipt_id chaining. Add receipts.py to the scanner text-rule exemption list per amendment A8.
validation: grep -n 'receipts.py' src/dopemux/dcp/red_lane_rules.py confirms exemption entry present.

steps.task: Add .dcp/ to .gitignore. Update schemas/dcp/manifest.json to include the evolved dcp_helper_receipt contract entry at L1 with contract_version 0.1.0 and REPO_VALIDATED provenance. Run provenance-completeness gate: assert all schema fields have provenance tags.
validation: manifest.json parses and includes dcp_helper_receipt entry.
Provenance-completeness check: count of provenance-tagged fields equals count of schema properties.

steps.task: Write proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-106/APPROVAL.json (hand-authored, redlane requirement per design B.6). The artifact must be schema-valid against dcp_approval_artifact schema, have requester != approver, decision 'allow', and scope covering schemas/dcp/** paths touched in this packet.
validation: python -c "import json; a=json.load(open('proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-106/APPROVAL.json')); assert a['requester'] != a['approver'], 'requester must != approver'" exits 0.
python -c "import json; a=json.load(open('proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-106/APPROVAL.json')); assert a.get('decision') in ('allow','gated'), 'decision must be allow or gated'" exits 0.

steps.task: Run full test suite for receipt module, write proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-106/PROOF.json recording command outputs, exit codes, git state, validation state, PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN buckets, and residual risks. Confirm diff scope stays within allowlist.

Auditor identity in PROOF.json differs from implementer identity.
